question: What is the full form of ‘PM-SYM’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan** (PM-SYM) is a pension scheme launched by the Government of India.
 
• It aims to provide social security to unorganized workers.
 
• Under this scheme, subscribers receive a minimum assured pension of Rs. 3000 per month
